What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

About Doctorflix

Medizin entwickelt sich schneller als je zuvor, und Ärzte müssen ihr ganzes Berufsleben lang mithalten. Doctorflix ist die digitale Plattform, auf der Ärzte im deutschsprachigen Raum lernen: kostenlos, zertifiziert und mit dem größten Angebot im Markt. Weil wir dort sind, wo Ärzte ihr Wissen auf den neuesten Stand bringen, sind wir auch der Kanal, über den Pharma- und MedTech-Unternehmen sie relevant erreichen. Unsere Vision: die führende Plattform für medizinisches Wissen zu werden, zuerst in DACH, dann international. Ein Ort, an dem Ärzte lernen, sich austauschen und bessere Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten treffen. Wir sind ein VC-finanziertes Startup aus Berlin und wachsen organisch wie anorganisch.


Role

Wir sind aus der frühen Startup-Phase herausgewachsen: ein neues Sales-Team, neue Produkte, anorganisches Wachstum in Vorbereitung, der Schritt ins Ausland in Sicht. Was uns jetzt bremst, sind nicht fehlende Ideen, sondern Prozesse, die nicht mitwachsen.

Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern Hans und Leo und machst aus Strategie ein laufendes System. Du baust unsere Operations so um, dass sie bei doppelter Größe noch funktionieren, automatisierst, was kein Mensch mehr tun sollte, und übernimmst die Projekte, die über unser nächstes Jahr entscheiden.

Das ist weder eine Assistenzrolle noch ein reiner Strategie-Job. Du schreibst nicht die Folie über den Prozess. Du baust den Prozess und, wo es Sinn ergibt, den Agenten, der ihn ausführt.

We are looking for a Propellant Quality Control Engineer to ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of the materials and processes used to manufacture our solid propellants. Working closely with the Lead Propellant Manager, laboratory technicians, propulsion engineers, manufacturing, and suppliers, you will define and execute quality-control activities from incoming raw materials through to finished propellant.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with a disciplined approach to measurement, documentation, investigation, and process control. Your work will help ensure that propellant development and production remain safe, repeatable, and aligned with the required performance standards.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and perform quality-control checks for raw materials, intermediate products, and finished propellant.

  • Develop and maintain inspection plans, test methods, acceptance criteria, sampling requirements, and quality records.

  • Review laboratory and production data to identify trends, variation, out-of-specification results, and emerging process issues.

  • Lead or support investigations into non-conformances, deviations, material issues, and unexpected test results.

  • Maintain clear traceability of materials, batches, samples, equipment, results, and technical decisions.

  • Work with the Lead Propellant Manager and manufacturing teams to improve process capability, measurement quality, and production consistency.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in quality control, quality engineering, laboratory testing, or process control within a chemical, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

  • A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of measurement systems, test methods, sampling, data review, and technical documentation.

  • Experience investigating non-conformances, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

  • A methodical and detail-oriented approach to safety, traceability, data integrity, and compliance.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, energetic materials, Elastomers, polymers, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, or catalysts.

  • Propellant or chemical-material characterisation, including thermal, mechanical, rheological, chemical, or burn-rate testing.

  • Incoming-material inspection, supplier quality, batch release, certificate-of-analysis review, or material qualification.

  • Statistical process control, measurement-system analysis, capability studies, trend analysis, or uncertainty assessment.

  • Experience with hazardous chemicals, explosives, regulated materials, or formal laboratory and manufacturing quality systems.

  • Python, MATLAB, laboratory information systems, electronic records, or other tools for quality and test-data analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Who we are 
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

solutions-architect-berlin-31175,Apaleo,Solutions Architect f/m/d,"

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.
• High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
• High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
• High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
• Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

• Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
• Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.

• Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.

• Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
• Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
• Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
• Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
• Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.
• You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
• You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
• You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
• You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
• You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.
Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership.
• Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
• Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
• Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
• A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
• Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
• Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
• Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
• Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK
• Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
• Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
• Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
• Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
• Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
• Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
• Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
• Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted
• Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
• Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
• Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

column3: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.

column2: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

Job Description

AI orchestration is at the centre of where Flip is going. Fusion, a multi-agent code-generation system sits at the core of our newest product, and our Ask AI agent gateway and Flip Flows automation both run on capabilities our AI engineers build and maintain.

As Lead AI Engineer you take over the AI discipline: you own the how (architecture, standards, technical direction) across all three surfaces, you lead and grow a team of three AI engineers, and you stay hands-on where the problems are hardest.

What you can expect

  • Own the AI architecture: Define and align a coherent AI architecture and set of standards across Flip Fusion, Ask AI agent gateway, and Flip Flows.

  • Tackle the hardest challenge: Multi-agent systems, built to specific purposes, generalizable enough for diverse customers, balancing high expectations with feasibility, reliability and cost effectiveness.

  • Lead and grow the discipline: Take over people leadership for three AI engineers and help them level up into engineers who set the technical bar themselves.

  • Stay hands-on: Roughly 70 percent of your time stays in the code, on the problems where your judgment matters most. The rest is technical and people leadership.

  • Influence across products: Land architecture decisions with the product managers and engineering leads who own the roadmaps you don't, by making the better argument rather than by mandate.

  • Work with our stack: Python, pydantic-ai for orchestration, qdrant for vector search, Azure AI for models, deployed on Kubernetes into a mostly JVM-based (Kotlin, Micronaut) and Go backend.

  • Shape a young discipline: AI engineering at Flip is new enough that there is enormous design space and no inherited playbook.

What you bring to the table

We're looking for an engineer with a software engineering foundation and real production depth in agentic systems, who wants to lead a discipline rather than just work a codebase. If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a senior or staff-level track record, built on a software engineering foundation (backend, platform, or full-stack)

  • Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered systems in production: RAG, tool calling and MCP, orchestration, and evals. Not prototypes, systems you lived with after go-live.

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration, weighted heavily. This is the core of what you would be architecting.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: architecture ownership, tech lead responsibility, RFCs, design reviews, or setting standards for a team.

  • Proven ability to move technical work you don't own: you win architecture arguments through persuasion and credibility, and you're comfortable being right without being in charge.

  • Evidence that you grow people: coaching or mentoring engineers into stronger engineers rather than absorbing the work yourself.

  • A clear, explicit commitment to people leadership. This role includes managing three engineers and that is not the part you tolerate to get the technical scope.

  • Strong communication skills and business-fluent English (C1).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Formal people-management experience: line management, performance and development conversations, hiring. Strong mentoring evidence counts just as much.

  • Experience leading a discipline or craft across teams in a matrix organisation.

  • Product context at scale: frontline or deskless workforces, high-volume B2B SaaS, or comparable.

  • Cost, latency and reliability engineering for LLM systems: guardrails, fallbacks, evaluation harnesses.

  • German at any level. Useful in parts of the company, never required for this role.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

platform-engineer-gn-at-ai-efficiency-venture-berlin-76033,atlantic.vc,"Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Efficiency Venture, Berlin","

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there
column2:
knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.
column3:
>

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.
column4:
>

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.
column5:
>

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.
column6:
>

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step.
column7:
>

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • Practical agentic engineering experience: you use coding agents effectively and can develop and evaluate their workflows, while independently understanding, reviewing and debugging the code they produce.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

Fluent English is required
column9:

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

Standort: Hamburger Westen | Hybrid (60% remote)

Du hast schon einige Security-Projekte gesehen.
Einige liefen genau so, wie sie geplant waren. Andere haben dich vermutlich mehr gelehrt als jede Zertifizierung.
Genau deshalb könnte diese Rolle spannend für dich sein.
Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen aus einer stark regulierten Branche mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich IT Security.
Die Rolle wurde nicht geschaffen, weil Security ""auch irgendwie wichtig"" ist.
Sondern weil der verantwortliche Teamleiter IT-Security mittlerweile so viele Themen verantwortet, dass er einen Teil davon in erfahrene Hände geben möchte.
Gesucht wird also niemand, der Tickets bearbeitet oder Häkchen in Audits setzt.
Gesucht wird jemand, der Verantwortung übernehmen möchte.


Deine Aufgaben

Dein Alltag wird sich irgendwo zwischen operativer Security, Cloud Security und Projektarbeit bewegen.

Unter anderem geht es um:

  • Security Reviews neuer Systeme, Anwendungen und Technologien
  • Cloud Security im Azure- und GCP-Umfeld
  • Incident Management
  • Weiterentwicklung der Security-Landschaft
  • Bearbeitung von Findings aus Audits
  • Security-Projekte in einem internationalen Umfeld
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur-, Cloud- und Applikationsteams
Aktuell entstehen viele neue Themen und Veränderungen. Entsprechend gibt es ausreichend Möglichkeiten, eigene Erfahrungen einzubringen und Dinge mitzugestalten.


Dein Profil

Uns ist bewusst, dass niemand jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt.
Wichtiger ist:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich IT Security
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien und Cloud Security ist ein Must-Have
  • Eigenständig vorangetriebene IT-Security-Projekte
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Neugier, Teamgeist und Interesse an neuen Themen und Technologien

  • Flexibles Arbeiten und Gleitzeit
  • 30 Urlaubstage

Einleitung

Für ein Unternehmen im Bereich Versicherungsdienstleistungen in der Region Norddeutschland sind wir auf der Suche nach einem Senior IT Security Administrator (gn) für die Festanstellung.

In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie sowohl operative als auch strategische Verantwortung im Bereich IT-Security und gestalten die Sicherheitsarchitektur des Unternehmens aktiv mit.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitslösungen sowie Durchführung von Vulnerability Assessments und Penetrationstests
  • Verwaltung von Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Zugriffskonzepten (IAM/PAM)
  • Überwachung und Absicherung von Cloud-Umgebungen (z. B. Microsoft Azure) und hybriden Infrastrukturen
  • Weiterentwicklung und Pflege einer unternehmensweiten IT-Security-Strategie und Roadmap
  • Erstellung und Fortschreibung von Sicherheitskonzepten, Richtlinien und Standards (z. B. ISMS nach ISO 27001)

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security/Cybersecurity, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer Senior- oder Leadfunktion
  • Fundiertes Know-how in Netzwerksicherheit, Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, IAM/PAM, SIEM und Vulnerability Management
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsframeworks wie ISO 27001 oder BSI IT-Grundschutz
  • Kenntnisse aktueller Bedrohungslagen, Angriffsvektoren und Gegenmaßnahmen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für komplexe fachliche Diskussionen

  • Vielfältige interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie 13. Gehalt, Urlaubsgeld und Fahrtkostenzuschuss

Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

We're hiring a technical recruiter to own hiring across Science, Engineering and Data Science. These are three distinct talent markets with three distinct assessment bars, and you'll own all of them end-to-end. We're scaling fast, and competing directly with the best-funded labs in the world for the same people.

Your Responsibilities

  • Manage, negotiate and close offers, including against competing frontier-lab packages

  • Manage the pipeline operationally in the ATS with clean stages and weekly metrics

The experience we are looking for

  • 5+ years in-house technical recruiting at a deep-tech, AI/ML, or research-led startup (Series A and ), or in a frontier lab's talent team

  • Track record closing ML researchers or research engineers against top tier frontier labs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Mistral)

  • Modern ATS architecture (Ashby or equivalent): stage design, rejection taxonomy, funnel reporting

The behaviours we want you to bring everyday to the office

  • High agency and ownership and operates as a full stack recruiter

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Berlin team is looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Infotainment, to provide hands-on technical leadership for complex embedded software and hardware/software integration work. You will help shape architectures that connect vehicle hardware, embedded operating systems, platform services, communication paths, and user-facing behavior into reliable products.

This is a broad technical role for an engineer who can move comfortably between system-level design and implementation. You will work across current and next-generation vehicle platforms, helping teams take ideas from early architecture through development, integration, validation, and production readiness. You’ll be working in a high-performing forward-deployed team working closely with key OEM stakeholders. Examples include physical input, HMI systems and bespoke in-vehicle touchpoints.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.

You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

Women are diagnosed on average four years later than men, across 770 different diseases. They spend 25 % more of their lives in poor health. That is the gender health gap, and science says two things keep it open: too little access to specialists in women's health, and far too little research on women in the first place.
Step One: we turn ordinary statutory gynaecological practices into digital care champions. So that the specialists we do have can care for more patients properly, within the resources they are given.
Step Two: we turn generalist doctors into specialists by equipping them with clinical diagnostic and decision support built specifically for women's health, trained on data collected by Step One.

• Backed by industry angels from pharmaceuticals and medical publishing
• Innovation grant secured from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy
• Part of the Lausitz Model Region, giving us deep integration into the statutory system and reach to women regardless of their spending power
• MVP in pilot phase with real practices (Stack: Flutter, Supabase, Postgres. Up for debate once you join)
• Pre-seed stage, with funding in place to bring you on
We are looking for our first engineer to build femote's product and shape the technical foundation it grows on.

As our founding engineer, you will build our first SaaS product, a patient app and a professional interface, under European General Product Safety Regulation guidelines in the first year while we prepare for medical device certification in year two.

• You set the pattern, not just the code. Everything the first engineer does becomes the default for everyone after. You write it down, you teach it, and you build with that in mind.

Our team is technical enough that you don't have to translate engineering reality into business language.

Frederike Kugland, Founder: Quit her job for yeast infections. Built a company around it.

>Wir suchen einen Senior Consultant, der mit uns die digitale Transformation im Kundenumfeld der Sozialversicherung gestaltet. In dieser Rolle begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung, analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst fachliche und digitale Lösungen für moderne Verwaltungs- und Leistungsprozesse. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden und Partnern zusammen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein, um nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu schaffen und echte Mehrwerte zu erzielen.


Was Dich erwartet

Die digitale Sozialversicherung von morgen gestalten: Du unterstützt Träger und Organisationen der Sozialversicherung bei der Digitalisierung und Modernisierung ihrer Fach- und Verwaltungsprozesse. Dabei begleitest Du unsere Kunden von der strategischen Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und leistest einen aktiven Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung moderner Verwaltungsleistungen. 
Fachliche Beratung: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Optimierungs- und Harmonisierungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kunden nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Dabei bringst Du eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest die digitale Transformation aktiv mit. 
Anforderungen verstehen – Lösungen entwickeln: Du erfasst, strukturierst und bewertest fachliche Anforderungen aus komplexen Verwaltungs- und Sozialversicherungskontexten. Aus regulatorischen, organisatorischen und fachlichen Vorgaben entwickelst Du praxisnahe Konzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung. 
Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du koordinierst fachliche Themen zwischen Kunden, Partnerdienstleistern und internen Teams und sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Interessen erfolgreich zusammengeführt werden. Dabei fungierst Du als vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für alle Projektbeteiligten. 
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst Projektmanagementaufgaben in Digitalisierungs-, Transformations- und Modernisierungsprojekten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Entwicklungsteams zusammen und begleitest die Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in digitale Lösungen. Von der Planung über die Steuerung bis zur Umsetzung behältst Du Termine, Abhängigkeiten und Projektergebnisse im Blick. 
Workshops und Wissenstransfer: Du planst, moderierst und dokumentierst Workshops, Fachgespräche und Abstimmungsrunden mit Kunden, Partnern und Stakeholdern. Darüber hinaus vertrittst Du fachliche Themen in Gremien und Arbeitsgruppen und unterstützt den nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer. 
Qualität und Kundenerfolg: Durch strukturierte Beratung, zielgerichtetes Projektmanagement und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt Du unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Transformation erfolgreich umzusetzen.


Dein Profil

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und sicheres Auftreten in Workshops und Gremien  
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge klar und verständlich darzustellen  
  • Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen und tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln  
  • Fähigkeit, eigenständig praxisorientierte fachliche Lösungsvorschläge zu entwickeln und komplexe Anforderungen aus regulierten Verwaltungs- und Sozialversicherungskontexten zu bewerten   
  • Bereitschaft zur engen Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams im Rahmen der Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen

  • Eigenständige Weiterentwicklung fachlicher und strategischer Themen 
  • Bereitschaft zu Reisen sowie zu Einsätzen vor Ort bei Kunden und Partnerdienstleistern  
  • Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in deutscher Sprache

Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

How you'll get there:

  • Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

  • Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

  • Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

  • Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.

What you bring:

  • You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

  • You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

  • You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

  • You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

  • You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

  • You explain complex things simply, to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

column2:
DR

We are looking for one cracked founding engineer to build the AI that plans large residential buildings end to end: the agent harness, the data and context layer, and the evals. You work in a small, high-agency team on real projects that ship right away.

Your role

  • Harness engineering: You build and run the layer around the model end to end: memory, tool orchestration, verification, drawing and document generation, so the output stays consistent and code-compliant at scale.

  • Data and context: You turn messy planning data (CAD/BIM models, PDFs, site surveys, building codes) into the right context at every phase, always traceable back to its source.

  • Evals and benchmarks: You build the eval harness (datasets, regression tests) and measure our agents against the architectural rule sets and judgment calls.

  • BIM and IFC automation: You connect to the architect's toolchain (Revit, ArchiCAD, IFC) to drive automated modeling and clean interoperability.

  • Hands-on experience with harness engineering: agents, tool orchestration, evals.

  • High agency and an entrepreneurial drive. Ideally, you have founded before or want to. You find the work yourself and move fast.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment (startup, scale-up or similar).

  • Nice to have: German, Revit, IFC or Grasshopper, a non-linear CV and experiments with reinforcement learning (MCTS, GRPO, RLHF) or diffusion models (discrete and continuous).

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and a stake in the company, with first-hire upside

  • Real projects that ship right away

  3. A technical interview.

  4. A trial day on-site in Munich. We pick a problem together and build it side by side.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

senior-data-engineer-full-time-berlin-70853,Glimmer,Senior Data Engineer (Full-time),"

Pregnancy, childbirth, and early parenthood bring about a lot of changes. And with each phase, new questions arise: small ones, big ones, practical ones, emotional ones. Glimmer helps to see more clearly what's happening right now, what's important, and what's right.

We combine in-depth expert knowledge, a digital midwife consultation service, and practical tips in one app. This way, customers will find reliable answers, prenatal and postpartum recovery classes, and support all in one place. Accessible, compassionate, and tailored.

Glimmer is covered by over 80 health insurance providers and supports customers from their child's first heartbeat to their first steps. So they can navigate this journey with greater clarity, confidence, and peace of mind.

Glimmer is a Berlin-based start-up with around 40 employees. As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll be part of the Data & Engineering team and play a key role in building the data foundations that help us turn insight into better care for every family we support.

Role Overview:
We're looking for a motivated and highly autonomous Data Engineer to build and own the foundations of our data platform. You'll enjoy this role if you like ownership, can design reliable and scalable data pipelines, and care about giving every team clean, trustworthy data. You'll also be handling sensitive health data, so we need someone who treats privacy and security as core engineering principles.

Over the last seven years, and through several acquisitions, our data landscape has grown into a patchwork of systems, pipelines and workarounds. Your biggest impact will be replacing that complexity with a single, modern data warehouse and a platform that is simple, well documented and easy to build on.

• Within your first 3 months: You've mapped our current data landscape, including legacy systems, inherited sources from acquisitions, pipelines and dependencies, and you've shared a clear target architecture and migration plan that the team supports.
• Within 6 months: The foundations of the new data warehouse are live, the most important data sources are migrated, and the first legacy pipelines and tools have been retired.

• Within 12 months: The new warehouse is our single source of truth. Redundant systems are gone, core metrics are defined consistently across the business, and teams trust the data without double-checking it.

• Throughout: Data is easier to find, understand and use. Onboarding a new source or answering a new question takes days, not weeks, and the platform is documented well enough that it doesn't depend on any one person.
• Design, build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and PostgreSQL
• Own and evolve our cloud data infrastructure on AWS (primarily EC2 & RDS), balancing performance, reliability, security and cost.
• Own the end-to-end engineering of our automated insurance invoicing pipeline, so that reimbursement, claim status and financial data flow accurately and reliably into downstream systems
• Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that connect product, web, CRM and advertising platforms (e.g. Amplitude, Meta, Google Ads, HubSpot) into a unified data model
• Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external tools and SaaS products via REST APIs
• Design and implement data models and warehouse schemas that support business reporting, product analytics, experimentation and regulatory requirements
• Put data quality, testing, monitoring and alerting in place so problems are caught before they reach stakeholders
• Orchestrate and automate workflows, and apply software engineering best practices (version control, CI/CD, code review, documentation)
• Make sure data is handled in line with GDPR, health data privacy requirements, and internal policies, including access control, pseudonymisation and retention policies
• Work closely with Marketing, Product and Finance to understand their data needs and deliver datasets that feed tools such as AWS Quicksight
• Share knowledge and coach team members on data concepts, tooling and best practices
• 3+ years' experience in Data Engineering or a closely related role, ideally in a startup or scale-up
• Strong hands-on skills in SQL, Python, PostgreSQL and AWS (EC2/RDS)
• A track record of building and owning data pipelines and warehouse architectures from scratch in fast-moving environments
• Experience with API integrations, workflow automation and version control (GitHub)
• Solid understanding of data modelling, data quality practices and pipeline observability
• Awareness of data privacy and security, ideally with experience handling sensitive or regulated data (GDPR)
• Nice to have: experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Dagster), transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), infrastructure as code, or BI tools like AWS Quicksight
• A high degree of autonomy, curiosity and ownership
• Fluent in English, German is a plus
• Real Ownership from Day 1: You'll own the architecture and foundations of our data platform, not just execute a roadmap, but shape it.

• Growth Through Challenge, Not Stagnation: You'll build deep expertise in modern data architecture, regulated health data handling, and cross-functional platform ownership, while coaching others along the way.
• Close to the Business: You'll work closely with Marketing, Product and Finance, seeing firsthand how clean, trustworthy data shapes real decisions across the company.
• Purpose: You're building the data backbone for a digital health platform that supports women and families through pregnancy, birth and early parenthood.
• Mentoring & Team Culture: You'll be part of a motivated, diverse team that shares knowledge and supports each other.
• Community: Regular team breakfasts and fixed celebrations throughout the year keep the team connected.
• Work-Life & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, an Urban Sports Club membership and 3 months remote work allowance are waiting for you.
• Screening Call (15 min) A quick intro to get to know each other.
• First Interview (45 min) A deeper conversation about your experience and the role.
• Case Study (4 hours) A practical task that reflects the kind of work you'd be doing with us.
• Case Study Interview (1.5 hours) We'll walk through your solution together.
• Final Round (1 hour) Meet the team and get a feel for how we work.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Team

Our Product team works at the intersection of AI research, engineering and customer needs to shape the future of autonomous driving at Wayve. We define product direction, translate complex technical capabilities into clear roadmaps, and bring cross-functional teams together to turn research into products that deliver real-world impact.

Working closely with engineers, researchers, programme managers and automotive partners, we balance long-term ambition with practical delivery. We combine technical depth with product judgement, listen carefully to our customers and teams, and create alignment around what to build, why it matters and how we’ll measure success.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers and PMs without formal authority. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and motivate them through hard, ambiguous problems.

  • Communicate crisply across audiences, from deep technical reviews with engineers, to executive updates with leadership, to customer-facing conversations.

  • Listen actively to engineers, partners and customers, and turn what you hear into better decisions and stronger team alignment.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

This is not a typical BDR seat. It is the chance to build our enterprise go-to-market from zero. Enterprises want to deploy humanoids. Your job is to find them, reach them first, and bring them in. The market, the outreach, and the first conversation are yours to build.

What You Will Do

  • Own outreach and first contact. Bring the enterprises that want to deploy humanoids to us.

  • Generate and qualify leads across enterprise accounts.

  • Own one or more markets end to end. Your territory, your pipeline, your number.

  • Continuously improve how we reach enterprise companies. New channels, new angles, kill what does not work.

  • Book qualified meetings and hand over the context to close.

Requirements

  • A track record of excellence, wherever you earned it: a top-tier VC, a startup, or a company you built yourself.

  • Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the lists, write the emails, and chase the follow-ups yourself.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in two languages.

  • Based in Munich, in the office.

Nice to Have

  • A strong academic background. We care more about what you have done than where you studied.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • ""That’s not my job"" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the ""what"" and ""why"" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.


What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree

Built on dlt, dltHub is the AI-native data engineering platform for teams of humans and agents: a managed layer over any warehouse that lets both your team and their agents generate, validate, and manage high-quality data at scale.

column9:
>Wir sind Xempus, Deutschlands führende unabhängige Software-as-Service (SaaS)-Plattform für den Vertrieb und die Verwaltung betrieblicher Vorsorgelösungen. Unsere Mission: Betriebliche Vorsorge digital und verständlich, effizient und für jeden zugänglich zu machen. Seit 2007 arbeiten wir stetig daran, die Digitalisierung der Versicherungsbranche voranzutreiben. Wir bei Xempus sind davon überzeugt, dass wir alle gemeinsam etwas bewirken können – egal von wo! Ob von einem unserer Büros oder von zu Hause ­– Komm zu uns und lass uns gemeinsam eine sicherere Zukunft für alle schaffen!


Was Dich erwartet

  • Du führst unsere Software Engineers disziplinarisch und fachlich. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit mehreren cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen und unterstützt sie bei ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Engineering-Aktivitäten mit der Unternehmensvision und den strategischen Produktzielen von Xempus im Einklang stehen.
  • Du verantwortest technische Initiativen von der Konzeption bis zum produktiven Betrieb – einschließlich technischer Planung, Architektur, Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Gemeinsam mit Product Ownern priorisierst du technische Themen im Product Backlog und schaffst Transparenz über Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und notwendige Investitionen.
  • Du triffst fundierte technische Entscheidungen, reviewst Lösungsansätze und stellst die Einhaltung von Engineering-Standards, Best Practices und Qualitätsanforderungen sicher.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Operations, Customer-facing Teams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um technische Möglichkeiten mit geschäftlichen Anforderungen zu verbinden.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Engineering-Prozesse, Wissensmanagement-Formate und Standards kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit.
  • Du begleitest Projekte und Produkte bis in den produktiven Betrieb und stellst gemeinsam mit den Teams einen zuverlässigen laufenden Betrieb sicher.


Wonach wir suchen

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Softwarearchitektur und kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen vermitteln.
  • Du bringst umfassende Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Java mit – idealerweise mit tiefgehender Expertise im Spring Framework, insbesondere Spring Boot, sowie in gängigen Java-Bibliotheken und -Standards.
  • Du kannst dich schnell in große, komplexe Codebasen einarbeiten, erkennst übergreifende Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus fundierte Architekturentscheidungen ab.
  • Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns, Clean Code und modernen Engineering-Prinzipien.
  • Du denkst strategisch und kannst langfristige Pläne für die Weiterentwicklung, Modernisierung und schrittweise Verbesserung gewachsener Systeme entwickeln und umsetzen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, bestehende Systeme zu analysieren, zu refaktorieren und nachhaltig zu verbessern – ohne Stabilität und Performance aus dem Blick zu verlieren.
  • Du kennst dich mit Datenbanken, APIs und dem gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess aus – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung von Software Engineers.
  • Du kannst technische Projekte strukturieren, priorisieren und gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern erfolgreich umsetzen.
  • Du treibst den Einsatz von KI aktiv voran - von KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung über automatisierte Qualitätssicherung bis hin zur Optimierung unserer Entwicklungsabläufe.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern und agierst souverän zwischen Engineering, Product, Management und externen Partnern.
  • Du arbeitest gerne in einem agilen Umfeld, gehst konstruktiv mit Veränderungen um und bringst dich aktiv in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.
  • Erfahrung mit Java Script Frontend Frameworks (Vue.js, React) ist ein Plus.
  • Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit einem guten Gespür für geschäftliche Zusammenhänge und unternehmerische Prioritäten.
  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Aufgaben

Unsere Produkte sind der Grund, warum Kund:innen bei uns kaufen und immer wieder zurückkommen. Als Director Product (m/w/d) verantwortest du alles, was dahintersteht, für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group: von der ersten Produktidee über Sourcing und Produktion bis zur Lieferung ins Lager. Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain aber auch Quality Management und ESG sind dein Kern, und genau dort bist du strategisch wie operativ tief drin.

Du setzt die Richtung, führst die Heads und ihre Teams und hältst die Fäden über alle Abteilungen hinweg zusammen. Wenn es darauf ankommt, sitzt du selbst mit am Tisch der Supplier. Kurz: Du bist die Person, die unser Produkt-Business nach vorne bringt, mit Weitblick und mit beiden Händen im Tagesgeschäft.



Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktstrategie: Du entwickelst mit den PD-Heads und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO Rehan die Produkt- und Sortimentsstrategie für unsere Marken, bewertest neue Kategorien und übersetzt alles in eine klare Roadmap.

  • Product Development: Du steuerst die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Launches, challengst Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten erfolgreiche Produkte werden.

  • Sourcing &
column2:
Supplier Management: Du verantwortest unsere Supplier-Landschaft, vor allem in China und Pakistan, baust eigene, belastbare Beziehungen auf und verhandelst Preise, Qualität und Timings gemeinsam mit unserem Supply Chain Team. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran.

  • Supply Chain: Du sorgst für eine stabile, effiziente Lieferkette von der Bestellung bis zur Ware im Lager und erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Performance &
column3:
Zahlen: Du hast die Performance der Brands und neuer Launches im Blick, gehst in Product Deep Dives und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten.

  • Leadership: Du führst die Heads sowie die Teams aus Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality Management und ESG mit Empathie, klaren Zielen und ehrlichem Feedback. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter.

  • Krisen- &
column4:
Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen.

  • Prozesse &
column5:
Workflows: Du baust Strukturen, die wirklich funktionieren, und machst unseren Produktbereich skalierbar.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist Schnittstelle zu fast allen Bereichen der Gruppe, von Brand und E-Commerce über Marketplace bis Finance, und bist Sparringspartner:in für Rehan.


    • Dein Profil

    • Studium: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Textilmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Noch wichtiger ist uns, was du in deiner Laufbahn schon aufgebaut und bewegt hast.

    • Erfahrung: Mindestens 8 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche.

    • Leadership-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen.

    • Product Development: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht.

    • Sourcing &
column6:
Supply Chain: Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen.

  • QM &
column7:
Sustainability: Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. 

  • Strategie &
column8:
Hands-on: Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab.

  • Verhandlungsstärke: Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird.

  • Sourcing-Netzwerk: Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso.

  • Mindset: Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um.

  • Reisebereitschaft &
column9:
Präsenz: Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan.

  • Sprachen: Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.


    • Warum wir?

    Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

    • Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu  betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
